hypothesis: Among names already in a positive 20-session trend with nonnegative 5-session return, a lower 5-to-20-session realized-volatility ratio identifies an orderly pause with better 5-session forward return distribution. This is a continuation thesis without a volume-trigger condition.
candidate_universe: All available symbols in the preserved TSE daily panel meeting only signal-time data-quality and family pool conditions.

conditions: Finite ret20 > 0 at the official session close.
Finite ret5 >= 0 at the official session close; no price-pullback condition.
The last 20 ret1 observations are finite and map to 20 consecutive official XTKS sessions.
Population standard deviation of the last 20 ret1 values is positive.
rv_ratio_5_20 = population_std(last 5 ret1) / population_std(last 20 ret1) is finite and < 1.0.
candidate_pool.missing_or_bad_data: Exclude from the candidate pool using only signal-time facts; preserve count and reason. Never bridge missing XTKS sessions.

features.timestamp: Signal date official close; all inputs available by that close.
features.rv_ratio_5_20: Population standard deviation (ddof=0) of ret1 over the latest 5 consecutive official sessions divided by the same over the latest 20 consecutive official sessions; ret1 is close-to-close. No volume, labels, post-signal prices, or intraday features.
features.ret20: Existing causal close-to-close return through signal close, secondary tie-break only.

ranking.score: Negative rv_ratio_5_20; no learned weights or fitted transforms.

selection.cooldown: One prior official XTKS session for symbols selected by that same independent policy; selected symbols only update state.
selection.names_per_day: Multiple symbols allowed up to each registered Top-N; no one-symbol/day cap.
selection.empty_pool: Abstain; do not substitute another signal or relax criteria.

target: Next official XTKS session open entry; close on the fifth official XTKS session including entry; canonical gross return, with round-trip cost sensitivities 0%, 0.5%, 1%. 0.5% is a research assumption, not measured execution cost.

periods.discovery_selection: 2022-07-01 through final 2023 signal date whose fifth-session exit is no later than the last 2023 official XTKS session.
periods.locked_confirmation: 2024 only after the frozen discovery family and at least one Top-N policy pass all existing registered gates; specification cannot change. Historical exposure means RETROSPECTIVE_PROVISIONAL, not true OOS.
periods.2025: Do not open in this experiment.
periods.2026: Do not open for selection; report-only rule remains unchanged.

family_gate: Use the existing PLAN M2/M3 Core gate unchanged: signal/cohort net mean and median, plus winner-Top3-excluded net mean, must be positive at 0.5% assumed cost. Incomplete candidate-day cohorts remain unresolved and cannot be reweighted from resolved members; if coverage prevents the registered gate, return INCONCLUSIVE.
policy_gate: Only if family gate is KEEP: compare independent Top1/2/3/5 under the existing M4 rule. Core pass requires positive net signal/cohort mean, median, and Top3-excluded mean; cohort mean improves over the same-active-date full-pool reference; loss10/loss20 do not worsen. Choose one passing N by discovery cohort mean, ties to smaller N. Otherwise SELECTION_COUNT_UNRESOLVED.
analysis_requirements: purged validation if fitted parameters exist

data_lineage.outcome_source: After freeze only, join canonical precomputed daily labels by date+symbol from batch01/.cache/core_moderate_ridge_discovery_labels.parquet; verify source SHA, target definition, uniqueness, coverage, and status. Re-key only for this experiment; unmatched/unresolved rows stay unresolved.

prohibitions: Do not read outcome values before the spec and source hashes are frozen.
Do not adjust the rv ratio window or cutoff after outcomes are opened.
Do not turn retrospective history into a true-OOS claim.
Do not use Yahoo daily OHLCV to synthesize missing hourly or 4-hour bars.
Do not add any Codex/LLM/API dependency to research runtime or production.
Do not modify production code, workflows, secrets, Discord, or spreadsheets.
